info.ultimaratio.mamba: The SAMP/T MAMBA is a Franco-Italian long-range air defense system designed to protect strategic sites and troops against airborne threats. Mounted on heavy truck chassis like the Renault Kerax, it fires Aster 30 missiles capable of intercepting aircraft, drones, cruise missiles, and ballistic missiles.
info.ultimaratio.hades: A concept between the nuclear HADES missile, dismantled in 1997 and the Kerax 8x8 of nowdays
info.ultimaratio.mamba_radar: The SAMP/T ARABEL radar is the acquisition and tracking unit of the SAMP/T battery. Mounted on a Renault Kerax truck, it has no weapons of its own: the operator in the second seat runs the mast. With SRS the deploy clip is left to that mod; without it the radar unfolds when the operator sits and folds when the seat is empty.
info.ultimaratio.samp_t_ng: The SAMP/T NG is the Ground Fire 300 radar of the next-generation SAMP/T battery, mounted on a Renault Kerax 8x8. Like ARABEL it has no weapons: the operator in the second seat runs the mast. With SRS, deploy and power are manual; without SRS the radar unfolds when the operator sits.
info.ultimaratio.thundart: THUNDART: French HIMARS-class rocket launcher. 8-round pod, unguided precision rockets. The pod stows while driving and re-lays when you stop. Designate with the artillery indicator and the launcher lays itself on the solution. Elevation 0-67°. Pod reload takes 60 s.
info.ultimaratio.renault_kerax: The Renault Kerax is a French 8x8 heavy truck. This unarmed civilian chassis is the same cab used by the SAMP/T battery.
info.ultimaratio.caesar: The CAESAR Mk1 is a French highly mobile self-propelled artillery system featuring a 155mm/52-caliber howitzer mounted on a 6x6 truck chassis. Known for its "shoot-and-scoot" capability, it can fire up to six rounds per minute at targets over 10k blocks away before quickly repositioning to avoid counter-battery fire.
info.ultimaratio.vbmr: The VBMR Griffon is a French 6x6 armored personnel carrier designed to transport an infantry squad under protection. A remotely operated 12.7 mm machine gun on the roof covers the vehicle without exposing the gunner.
info.ultimaratio.serval_dsa: The VBMR-L Serval DSA is the short-range air defence version of the Serval, with two Mistral missiles in launch tubes on the roof turret and a 7.62 mm machine gun. The rear stairs lower when stopped.
info.ultimaratio.serval: The VBMR-L Serval is a French 4x4 light armored vehicle carrying a squad of up to six. A roof-mounted remote 12.7 mm weapon station covers the vehicle without exposing the gunner.
info.ultimaratio.vbmr_mepac: The VBMR Griffon MEPAC is a mortar carrier on the Griffon chassis. A 2R2M 81 mm mortar fires from the rear compartment once the roof hatches are open, while the remote 12.7 mm gun still covers the vehicle.
info.ultimaratio.leclerc_xlr: The Leclerc XLR is the latest French main battle tank, with a 120 mm CN120-26 cannon, a coaxial machine gun and a remote 12.7 mm weapon station. Three crew: gunner, commander and driver.
info.ultimaratio.leclerc_azur: The Leclerc AZUR is an urban-combat kit for the Leclerc: extra slat armor at the rear and a remote 7.62 mm weapon station. The 120 mm CN120-26 and coaxial 7.62 mm stay. Three crew: gunner, commander and driver.
info.ultimaratio.rafale_c: The Dassault Rafale C is the French Air and Space Force single-seat multirole fighter, in F3 standard. Twin-engine delta-canard airframe, roughly twice as fast as the A-10. Weapons: 30 mm DEFA cannon (1), MICA or METEOR long-range air-to-air missiles (2, switch with N), Mk 82 bombs (3), Mk 84 bombs (4), SCALP-EG cruise missile (5). Sprint for afterburner; press the gear key to retract the landing gear.
